L6.1.quote: Key observation: a number m is a candidate for future terms iff gcd(m, a_i)>1 for all previous a_i. Equivalently, for every previous a_i, m shares a prime factor with a_i.
L6.1.note: Correct characterization asserted as an observation; no inductive proof is written out.

L6.2.note: Finiteness of core primes is only conjectured from computations; no large-prime erasure argument (q^k c construction) given.

L6.3.note: Periodicity only conjectured ('Empirically... eventually periodic'); no proof, and validity from n=1 never addressed.

parsed.notes: Tracking file: computations, correct but unproved characterization (C), and conjectures for finiteness (F) and periodicity (P). Full proof section says 'Not yet complete'; no mechanism written for all cases.
